name: the gate accepts any overlap, so a macro promising an unprescribed refund alongside credits goes out
a macro promising nothing is withheld, so a no-DSS case has no reply at all
the gate passes everything, so DSS no longer decides which remedy is offered
a DSS miss and an absent DSS lookup report the same reason, merging two different problems
find:
return set(), ("the DSS lookup returned nothing at all, so no remedy "
                       "is prescribed — this is the playbook being unavailable, "
                       "not a case it is silent about")
replace:
return set(), ("no DSS row matched this case, so no remedy is "
                       "prescribed and only replies that promise nothing "
                       "are available")

name: withheld macros are not counted, so a gated-out list reads as a list with nothing to offer
a matched DSS row naming no remedy is reported as clean, hiding that the reply was narrowed
find:
return set(), ("the matched DSS row names no remedy, so only replies "
                       "that promise nothing are available")
